# Dup Source

Dedicated duplicate-heading fixture pair (21-03 Task 3, adjacency case): a link to the second
of two identically-slugging headings, written with the numeric suffix, must resolve -- and the
same anchor written without a suffix must resolve to the first.

- Bare (resolves to the first Dup heading): [first](dup-target.md#dup)
- Suffixed (resolves to the second Dup heading): [second](dup-target.md#dup-1)
